close_reason: Merged into KITH-q7et.5 (same finding: #[non_exhaustive] on public error enums)
description:
None of the public error enums in library crates are marked #[non_exhaustive], which forces downstream crates to update match arms on every new variant addition — a breaking-change hazard.

Enums that should be #[non_exhaustive]:
- kith-core/src/error.rs: AuthError (line 5), KithError (line 23)
- kith-peer/src/lib.rs: PeerDeliveryError (line 679)
- kithd/src/tls.rs: TlsError (line 9)
- kithd/src/extractors.rs: CallerRejection (line 134)
- kithd/src/listener.rs: ListenerError (line 26)
- kith-tui/src/client.rs: ClientError (line 21), SseStatus (line 272)

Per Rust API guidelines (C-SEALED / C-NON-EXHAUSTIVE): public enums in library crates that represent extensible sets of errors should carry #[non_exhaustive] unless the full set is intentionally sealed.
title: Public error enums missing #[non_exhaustive]
